header_off_hint: Off - press the start key in game
header_toggle_key_tip:
Press this key in game to start or stop picking up.
Click the button, then press the key to use.
header_mouse_refused: The left and right mouse buttons cannot start picking: the plugin clicks with the left button itself. Choose a key, or mouse button 4 or 5.
header_restore_cursor: Put the cursor back when done
header_restore_cursor_tip: After the last item of a pile, the cursor returns to where it was before picking started.
header_intro: Picks up the items you tick below (and, if you like, anything worth more than a value), nearest first: it moves the cursor onto the item's label and clicks it.
header_settings_corrupt: Your settings file could not be read (it is not valid JSON). A copy was kept as config/settings.json.corrupt. The defaults are in use, and nothing is saved until you change a setting here.
header_settings_unreadable: Your settings file exists but could not be opened (another program may be using it). The defaults are in use for now; the file is not overwritten and is read again shortly.
header_skipped: {count} item(s) skipped after {clicks} clicks without success (inventory full or label hidden?).
header_retry_tip:
Clicks the skipped items again.
They are also retried after the next area change or when you restart picking.
pick_heading_help:
Open a category and tick the items you want picked up. The price next to each item comes from POEFixer's price list (Settings -> Prices), in the currency chosen under {section}.

Names match the English game client. The game's loot filter still decides which labels are visible: an item whose label your filter hides cannot be clicked and is skipped after a few tries.

New league items join their category by themselves once you have seen one on the ground.
pick_search_tip: Shows only the items whose name contains this text.
pick_select_shown_tip: Ticks every item the search shows (all of them when the search is empty).
pick_clear_shown_tip: Unticks every item the search shows.
value_enable: Also pick anything worth at least
value_enable_tip: On top of the items you ticked, picks any item whose price is at or above the value below, even if you never ticked it. Needs POEFixer's price list.
value_minimum_tip:
The price an item must reach, in the currency below.
Press Enter or click elsewhere to apply.
value_tolerance_tip:
Lowers the minimum a little, so items just under it count too.
Example: minimum {minimum} with {tolerance} picks anything worth {result} or more.
value_currency_tip: The currency prices are shown and compared in, here and in the item lists.
value_summary: Picks anything worth {price} or more, plus every ticked item.
value_no_prices: POEFixer has no price list yet.
value_no_prices_tip:
Prices are loaded by POEFixer itself (Settings -> Prices: league and refresh).
Until they arrive, only ticked items are picked and the lists show no prices.
speed_preset_tip:
Slow, Medium, Fast and Instant use tested timings. Choose Custom to set the three timings below yourself.
Actual speed also depends on the frame rate and how fast the game answers a click.
speed_check_every_tip: How often the ground is scanned for the next item.
speed_pause_tip: Waiting time after each click before the next item.
speed_hover_tip:
How long the cursor rests on the label before clicking,
so the game highlights it first.
speed_range_tip:
How far from your character an item may lie, in map cells.
Turn on "{option}" under {section} to see it while you adjust it.
speed_click_height_tip:
How far above the item's ground position the click lands, to hit its name label.
Raise it if pickups often need a second click; larger loot filter fonts need more.
safety_panel_tip:
Inventory, stash or vendor window.
The full-screen map does not stop picking.
safety_town_tip: No picking in towns and hideouts.
safety_enemy_tip: Waits until no hostile monster is within the range below, so picking never walks you into a fight.
safety_enemy_range_tip:
How close a hostile monster must be to stop picking, in map cells.
Turn on "{option}" under {section} to see it on the ground.
safety_lmb: You hold the left mouse button
safety_lmb_tip: Waits while you hold the left mouse button yourself, for example while moving or attacking.
safety_always: Picking also always stops while the POEFixer menu is open, during loading screens, while the game window is not in front, while the game is paused and while you are dead.
display_show_status_tip: A small status chip: picking, paused (and why), or off.
display_status_position_tip:
Where the status chip sits.
Auto My Aim's chip stacks below it when both use the same corner.
display_size_tip: Size of the status chip and the ring lines, relative to the POEFixer font.
display_ring_pick_tip: Draws the pickup range on the ground around your character.
display_ring_pick_colour_tip: Colour of the pickup range ring.
display_ring_enemy_tip: Draws the enemy range used by "{option}".
display_ring_enemy_colour_tip: Colour of the enemy range ring.
display_reset_tip: Restores the display settings above to their defaults.
diag_tip: Picking state, prices, the item panel and the items in range with their status.
diag_faults: Scan errors caught: {count} (each one skips a scan pass).
